text: Replaced the `<copyright holders>` placeholder and the 2025 year in license.txt with "Copyright © 2026 Matthias Cullmann, Roland Brand, Jan Babin and the yolo-twice contributors", taking the names from the bar9/yolo-twice collaborators (culmat, bar9, jan-ba) and their GitHub profiles. The fourth team member is not a collaborator yet, so the "contributors" clause covers them until their name is known. The change is uncommitted and sits alongside existing README.md and documentation/design.md edits.
